name: What are common reasons for a sudden loss of hot water?

mainEntity.name: What are common reasons for a sudden loss of hot water?

acceptedAnswer.text: A sudden loss of hot water can stem from several common issues. For gas water heaters, a pilot light going out or a faulty thermocouple is often the culprit. Electric water heaters might experience a tripped circuit breaker or a failed heating element. Tankless units could have ignition problems or sediment buildup. In some cases, it might be a larger issue like a leaking tank or a faulty thermostat. Our technicians will conduct a thorough inspection to accurately identify the cause.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common reasons for no hot water include pilot light issues, tripped breakers, faulty heating elements, or ignition problems in tankless units.
